product_family: ChatBot (ChatBot by Text) - AI-powered conversational agent for customer support, sales, and engagement across web, mobile, and messaging channels (Messenger, SMS, etc.). Part of broader Text platform including LiveChat and other communication tools.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type II recommended)
certifications.proof_quote: The platform holds SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS, and Data Privacy Framework compliance, along with WCAG 2.2 accessibility verification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of certification on the vendor's own domain. The vendor's blog list of held certifications (SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS, Data Privacy Framework, WCAG 2.2) does NOT include ISO 27001; the blog references ISO 27001 only as a standard organizations should pursue, not one the platform holds. The trust center (trust.text.com) does not confirm it either.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Text commits to subjecting all personal data received from European Union (EU), European Economic Area (EEA) and Switzerland to GDPR protections (Regulation EU 2016/679). Data Privacy Framework certification effective July 10, 2023.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA (California Consumer Privacy Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Recognition of consumer rights including data access, correction, and opt-out options. CCPA/CPRA compliance explicitly listed.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS (SAQ A level). Platform for ecommerce requires PCI DSS compliance for payment data handling.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Text has achieved certification under the EU-US DPF, obtaining adequacy status. This pivotal adequacy decision signifies that the United States provides an equivalent level of safeguard for personal data. Certification became effective July 10, 2023.

certifications.name: UK Data Bridge (UK Extension to EU-US DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: Text self-certified compliance with the UK Extension to the EU-US DPF, implemented through the Data Protection (Adequacy) (United States of America) Regulations 2023, effective October 12, 2023.

certifications.name: Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) certification valid as of September 15, 2024, recognized by Swiss Federal Council for adequate data protection.

certifications.name: WCAG 2.2 (Accessibility)
certifications.proof_quote: WCAG 2.2 accessibility verification included in platform certifications.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance found. ChatBot markets specifically to healthcare organizations, but HIPAA certification not mentioned in privacy policy, trust documentation, or security blog posts. Status unknown - may require enterprise contract negotiation.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance certification found despite extensive security documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Platform trains AI agent on customer-provided sources (website URL, help center docs, knowledge base, product docs) via RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Does NOT train on customer conversation data for model improvement. Customers fully control what data the agent learns from.
privacy.data_region: Global with multiple cloud regions (Google Cloud, AWS). Data may be processed outside customer's country. EU/UK data transfers protected by Standard Contractual Clauses (Module II SCCs) and Data Privacy Framework adequacy determinations.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: 256-bit TLS encryption (versions 1.2 and 1.3) on all connections

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Multiple copies of personal data with recovery capability; backup copies stored separately from primary systems

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Two-factor authentication (2FA) available. Passwords require minimum 12 characters with numbers, capitals, and special characters. OAuth 2.1 with short-lived tokens and PKCE mandate for API access.

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Least privilege access. Personnel deactivation upon service termination. Role-based access controls with documented security policies. Unique machine identities per agent.

security.name: Data Compartmentalization
security.value: Logical data compartmentalization between customers. Clients cannot access other clients' data.

security.name: Testing & Monitoring
security.value: Annual penetration testing. Annual risk assessments. Event logging maintained for minimum 10 days. Real-time monitoring and anomaly detection of agent actions. Immutable audit trails.

security.name: Infrastructure Security
security.value: Hosted on Google Cloud and AWS. Web Application Firewall for DDoS mitigation. Endpoint detection and response (EDR) on staff devices. Software supply chain scanning.

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Breach notification as required by law. Documented incident breach records maintained.

products.name: ChatBot (Web Widget)
products.data_scope: Pre-chat surveys, chat conversations, ticket content. Customer-provided training data only (website, help center, docs).
products.notes: Core product. Free 14-day trial. Pricing from $19/mo. Supports multichannel deployment (website, Messenger, SMS, etc.).

products.name: ChatBot for eCommerce
products.data_scope: Product catalog, customer data, transaction context. PCI DSS SAQ A compliance for payment handling.
products.notes: AI agent for product recommendations, sales, checkout assistance. Case study: Wembley Stadium ($1.5M in 8 months).

products.name: ChatBot for Healthcare
products.data_scope: Patient inquiries, appointment scheduling, general information. HIPAA compliance not publicly documented.
products.notes: Solution marketed for healthcare but HIPAA certification status unclear. Recommend enterprise assessment.

products.name: ChatBot for Education
products.data_scope: Student inquiries, enrollment support, general campus information.
products.notes: Use cases in student support and institutional communications.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription. Free trial (14 days, no credit card required). Pricing from $19/month individual to custom enterprise plans.
compare.data_residency: Global (Google Cloud and AWS infrastructure). EU/UK data transfers protected by DPF adequacy and SCCs. Not restricted to single region.
top_certs: EU-US / UK / Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework

flags: SOC 2 specificity: the vendor's blog states 'SOC 2 (Type II recommended)' but does not explicitly confirm Type II certification is held; this language suggests Type II is a goal rather than confirmed current status.
ISO 27001 not held: the vendor's security blog does not list ISO 27001 among the certifications the platform holds; it references ISO 27001 only as a standard organizations should pursue.
HIPAA gap: Platform markets to healthcare organizations but no HIPAA certification or compliance framework mentioned in public documentation. May be available under enterprise agreement only.
Text, Inc. is the vendor behind the ChatBot product (also known as ChatBot by Text), confirmed by the company's copyright notice and legal pages.

Blog vs official stance: Certifications sourced from blog post (educational content) rather than official compliance dashboard. Blog may represent aspirational standards or generic recommendations rather than current ChatBot.com status.
